entries.title: Ezekiel 33:1
segments: ¶Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:2
segments: "Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and say to them: 'When I bring the sword upon a land, and the people of the land take a man from their territory and make him their watchman,

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:3
segments: 'when he sees the sword coming upon the land, if he blows the trumpet and warns the people,

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:4
segments: 'then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and does not take warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood shall be on his [own] head.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:5
segments: 'He heard the sound of the trumpet, but did not take warning; his blood shall be upon himself. But he who takes warning will save his life.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:6
segments: 'But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet, and the people are not warned, and the sword comes and takes [any] person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood I will require at the watchman's hand.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:7
segments: "So you, son of man: I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; therefore you shall hear a word from My mouth and warn them for Me.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:8
segments: "When I say to the wicked, 'O wicked [man], you shall surely die!' and you do not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked [man] shall die in his iniquity; but his blood I will require at your hand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:9
segments: "Nevertheless if you warn the wicked to turn from his way, and he does not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:10
segments: ¶"Therefore you, O son of man, say to the house of Israel: 'Thus you say, "If our transgressions and our sins [lie] upon us, and we pine away in them, how can we then live?"'

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:11
segments: "Say to them: '[As] I live,' says the Lord GOD, 'I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why should you die, O house of Israel?'

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:12
segments: "Therefore you, O son of man, say to the children of your people: 'The righteousness of the righteous man shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression; as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall because of it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; nor shall the righteous be able to live because of [his righteousness] in the day that he sins.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:13
segments: "When I say to the righteous [that] he shall surely live, but he trusts in his own righteousness and commits iniquity, none of his righteous works shall be remembered; but because of the iniquity that he has committed, he shall die.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:14
segments: "Again, when I say to the wicked, 'You shall surely die,' if he turns from his sin and does what is lawful and right,

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:15
segments: "[if] the wicked restores the pledge, gives back what he has stolen, and walks in the statutes of life without committing iniquity, he shall surely live; he shall not die.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:16
segments: "None of his sins which he has committed shall be remembered against him; he has done what is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:17
segments: "Yet the children of your people say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' But it is their way which is not fair!

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:18
segments: "When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he shall die because of it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:19
segments: "But when the wicked turns from his wickedness and does what is lawful and right, he shall live because of it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:20
segments: "Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' O house of Israel, I will judge every one of you according to his own ways."

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:21
segments: ¶And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth [month], on the fifth [day] of the month, [that] one who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me and said, "The city has been captured!"

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:22
segments: Now the hand of the LORD had been upon me the evening before the man came who had escaped. And He had opened my mouth; so when he came to me in the morning, my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:23
segments: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying:

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:24
segments: "Son of man, they who inhabit those ruins in the land of Israel are saying, 'Abraham was only one, and he inherited the land. But we [are] many; the land has been given to us as a possession.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:25
segments: "Therefore say to them, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "You eat [meat] with blood, you lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood. Should you then possess the land?

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:26
segments: "You rely on your sword, you commit abominations, and you defile one another's wives. Should you then possess the land?"'

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:27
segments: "Say thus to them, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "[As] I live, surely those who [are] in the ruins shall fall by the sword, and the one who [is] in the open field I will give to the beasts to be devoured, and those who [are] in the strongholds and caves shall die of the pestilence.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:28
segments: "For I will make the land most desolate, her arrogant strength shall cease, and the mountains of Israel shall be so desolate that no one will pass through.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:29
segments: "Then they shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I have made the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed."'

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:30
segments: ¶"As for you, son of man, the children of your people are talking about you beside the walls and in the doors of the houses; and they speak to one another, everyone saying to his brother, 'Please come and hear what the word is that comes from the LORD.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:31
segments: "So they come to you as people do, they sit before you [as] My people, and they hear your words, but they do not do them; for with their mouth they show much love, [but] their hearts pursue their [own] gain.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:32
segments: "Indeed you [are] to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they do not do them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 33:33
segments: "And when this comes to pass-surely it will come-then they will know that a prophet has been among them."
